description: End-to-end autonomy verification. A minimal engineering mission whose deliverable is a single marker file the provider must create under a fresh authorized path. Exercises the full provider route: local-first -> local recovery exhausted -> provider creates the in-scope file -> Validation Engine proves it -> the Runtime commits the authorized deliverable -> gitClean true -> Release Manager RELEASE -> evidence + ledger. The provider never decides completion; only the Release Manager does.

objectives.goal: Create a single minimal marker file under src/app/autonomy-e2e/ recording that the engineering provider executed this mission end-to-end.
done_when: Exactly one file exists under src/app/autonomy-e2e/.
No file outside the authorized write scope is modified.

definition_of_done: Objective completed strictly within the authorized write scope.
